routeActions: Ride the first moving lattice and jump onto the original side islands when its path dips through the hot pasta. Rejoin it after each low section.
Follow the lower zigzag to the high outer red coin. Jump beside the edge, collect it, and return to the ledge.
Climb the eastern cage pole, collect the nearby red coin, then cross to the fixed pole. Climb and jump toward the high ledge to collect its red coin.

Activate the elevator, step back before it rises, and jump into the opening underneath to collect its red coin. Return around the lower loop, climb both poles again, board the returning elevator and ride it to the middle floor.
Board the sliding ferry as it approaches. Jump clear of the flame, ride to the opposite side, then climb the side staircase and jump for its high red coin.
Cross the moving gaps to the squeezing zigzag platform. Climb its complete alternating ramps and jump for the red coin near its upper turn.
Let the squeezing platform rise. On its last ramp, chain two short jumps and landings, then make the third jump over the original upper rail to reach the high landing.
Cross the three undulating platforms, collecting the red coin over the last. Jump from the final section onto the first cage landing.
Wait for the cage to rise, then board it and grab its pole. Jump from partway up the pole into the opening beneath the upper block; a full top jump hits the low ceiling.
Cross to the middle opening, catch its pole and slide down. Turn again after sliding, face away from the next landing, and jump from a low point through the opening.
Board the final cage as it rises, climb to its top and collect the eighth red coin. Wait for the highest point, jump toward the thin upper rail and air-dive at the top of the jump.

Immediately jump again after landing on the thin rail to stop the dive slide. Use standing crouch jumps between the final original ledges, follow the narrow second rail, and collect the star after its spawn animation.

mission.name: Eight Red Coins
mission.sourceScope: Eight-red-coin secret star in the complete platform approach stage. Separate Bowser boss arena and key/Grand Star are outside this first-star mission.
